"''I'm familiar with it. Why are you telling me this?|Sabé informs Jul Tambor of Darth Vader's location in Kantiema|}} '''Kantiema''' was a [[Water|river]]-port [[City|village]] on the [[planet]] [[Brentaal IV]]. Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire]] maintained a presence in the village. Kantiema was completely destroyed when the [[Skakoan]] nationalist [[Jul Tambor]] [[Bombing of Kantiema|bombed]] the village in an attempt to [[Death|kill]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. ==Description== Kantiema was a [[Water|river]]-port [[City|village]] located on the [[planet]]{{Databank|vanguard-squadron|Vanguard Squadron}} [[Brentaal IV]]. It lay on a river that ran near several [[mountain]]s. Sections of Kantiema were built over the water, including landing platforms for [[starship]]s. ==History== {{Quote|I know you've been ''preparing'' something ''special'' to ''kill Vader''. But the Empire's also holding ''captured Skakoan refugees'' in that village. Once Vader's ''clear'' of Kantiema, he's all yours.|Sabé, to Jul Tambor|}} By the [[time]] between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], the village was abandoned and had an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] presence. During this time, during the [[Skakoan]] nationalist[[Darth Vader (2020) 28|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 28]] [[Jul Tambor]]'s quest to [[Death|kill]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]]''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the former [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|Naboo Royal Handmaiden]] [[Sabé]] allied herself with Vader in a play to help the citizens of the planet [[Skako Minor]]. Sabé contacted Tambor and told him that Vader was in Kantiema but also mentioned that there were several Skakoan [[refugee]]s being held in Imperial custody there as well. [[File:BombingOfKantiema-2020DarthVader32.png|thumb|right|300px|The bombing of Kantiema]] Tambor inquired as to how many refugees were in Kantiema, and Sabé responded that there were twelve. Although she warned Tambor not to attack, the Skakoan nonetheless [[Bombing of Kantiema|bombed]] the village and completely destroyed it in an effort to eliminate Vader. He then victoriously proclaimed his indifference to the civilian casualties and declared that he would rule over the people of Skako Minor as [[foreman]]. However, Sabé's entire maneuver had been a ploy to expose Tambor. In actuality, Kantiema had been completely abandoned besides a pair of [[KX-series security droid]]s and an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]]. Meanwhile, the refugees had been with Sabé, and upon hearing Tambor's words, turned on their would-be ruler. ==Behind the scenes== Kantiema first appeared in the [[Darth Vader (2020) 32|thirty-second issue]] of the [[2020]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']]. The issue was written by [[Greg Pak]], illustrated by [[Ibraim Roberson]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[March 22]], [[2023]].{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/103063/star_wars_darth_vader_2020_32|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020) #32}} ==Appearances== *[[Darth Vader (2020) 32|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 32]] {{1st}} *[[Legacy (novel)|''Legacy'']] {{Ab|Legacy (audiobook)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Brentaal IV locations]] [[Category:Destroyed cities]]
